notes: Cliopatria shapes: the 106-153 growth to 80 E takes Dzungaria from the Northern Xiongnu remnant (Ikh Bayan page) and is cut back to the 91 shape (the 84 shape plus the Mongolian Plateau); the 197-223 shape of 5.22 M km2 is cut to Kebineng's 224 strip because the Xianbei 'had already split into many different groups' by the Jian'an era; the 224-237 shape ends in 235. Start: identity.start is 49 (Pianhe, the page's first Xianbei action as a power), not Cliopatria's 60. The infobox says established 3rd century BC, which is the Donghu split of about 208 BC (not drawn). Not settled: (1) how the Xianbei 'unified' by Tanshihuai were divided into his three sections (eastern Youbeiping to Liaodong, central Youbeiping to Shanggu, western Shanggu to Dunhuang and the Wusun, undated) and who held what after 181: the pages give no land; (2) the dating of Tanshihuai's expansion (Cliopatria 161; page silent); (3) the Murong's land in 235; (4) the extent in 60-83. Han and Wei relations: tribute in 54 (Yuchouben and Mantou to Guangwu), the Xianbei leaders' tribute after 207 and Kebineng's acknowledgement of Cao Pi in 220 are not drawn here: the han-dynasty, cao-cao and cao-wei dossiers carry the vassal tint if the pages support it. 'Gaoliu', 'Qiangu', Tian Yu and Wang Xiong (as a general) are not on the pages opened; the Tanshihuai page's Wuhouqin River fishing resettlement of 178 is not a border event. States that need dossiers: Tuoba Xianbei (suggested tuoba-xianbei; Dai, Northern Wei), Murong Xianbei, Duan Xianbei, Yuwen Xianbei (all 235 onward), Donghu (before 208 BC), Wuhuan, Dingling, Buyeo. Names for the gazetteer: none unknown; Liucheng (Chaoyang, Liaoning) and Shengle (near Hohhot) are approximated with radii around Chaoyang and Hohhot; Mount Danhan coordinates (113.97 E, 41.09 N, near Shangyi County) are the researcher's reading of the page's 'around present-day Shangyi County'. Budget: four pages opened of five. Fix pass after review ia-01-b (2026-10-18): (1) the Southern Xiongnu's Ordos-Hetao land (Cliopatria's Southern Xiongnu 91 shape, about 0.18-0.19 M km2) is taken out of the 91 gain and of every Xianbei keyframe from 91 to 235, because the southern-xiongnu dossier (same batch) holds it from 48 to 216 and no page gives it to the Xianbei; it is not added back in 216, when the Five Divisions pass to Cao Cao.
